selection.ownership: Syncfusion, Inc., Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, United States. Global BoldSign eSignature product; this edition is the documented US default host api.boldsign.com.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official BoldSign API key auth (X-API-KEY), US default host https://api.boldsign.com, GET /v1/plan/apiCreditsCount, GET /v1/document/list, GET /v1/document/properties, GET /v1/template/list, GET /v1/template/properties, regional EU/CA/AU hosts, Syncfusion RTP identity, and dated incident search (BoldSign / Syncfusion + security breach/incident). Bold Reports Standalone Report Designer CVEs are a different product. No qualifying current unresolved BoldSign eSignature API compromise was identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

Official BoldSign API keys use X-API-KEY. Documented US default host is https://api.boldsign.com (SDK: no extra configuration required for US). Credits, document list/properties, and template list/properties are cheap authenticated reads. Operator is Syncfusion, Inc. (Research Triangle Park, NC, US). Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found Bold Reports designer CVEs, a distinct product, not a BoldSign eSignature API compromise.

incidents.finding: CVE-2026-65689/65690 describe Bold Reports Standalone Report Designer path traversal. That is not the BoldSign eSignature API at api.boldsign.com.
incidents.limitation: Different Syncfusion product. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /v1/plan/apiCreditsCount, matching the pinned validator. This reads remaining credits and does not send a document.
Native pins documented US default https://api.boldsign.com because computed EU/CA/AU hosts are unsupported. Native category is productivity (source Communication is not in Rust CATEGORIES).

Returns raw BoldSign JSON under data. Optional Page and PageSize use official PascalCase query names. Array filters (SentBy, Recipients, Status, Labels, BrandIds) are omitted because native query templates would not match the source repeated-key encoding. Native omits Page when unset; official defaults to 1.
documentId is a required query parameter on GET /v1/document/properties.
